note: Primary fixture alias for #92586. Bash tool kills every command after ~5s (output file was replaced or could no longer be verified) when an EDR transiently hard-links new files. Faceplate: culled.
title: Bash tool kills every command after ~5s ("output file was replaced or could no longer be verified") when an EDR transiently hard-links new files
expected: A transient extra hard link with unchanged dev/inode is not a replaced file. Compare device and inode (and possibly owner/mode), or retry before killing. The error blaming another Claude Code process startup cleanup is misleading.
actual: Every Bash tool call dies ~5s after start, exit 137. Short commands like pwd run and the output file has correct content, but read-back is reported failed. Read tool reads the same file fine. No other Claude Code process active.
error: Command killed: its output file was replaced or could no longer be verified
outputUnavailable: bash output unavailable: output file /private/tmp/claude-501/<project>/<session>/tasks/<id>.output could not be read (unknown). This usually means another Claude Code process in the same project deleted it during startup cleanup.
identityCheckNote: output-file identity check introduced in 2.1.251 ("a sandboxed command cannot redirect or replace them")
repro: claude -p "run: echo hi && sleep 7 && echo alive" --allowedTools 'Bash(echo:*)'
workaround: Point CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR at a directory on a separately mounted volume (settings.json env works).
